on 1 April,
2026  1  IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA  CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION  CRIMINAL APPEAL Nos. OF 2026  (Arising out of SLP(Criminal) Nos.16799-16802/2025)
 NIVRUTTI RANGNATH SHINDE & ORS. Appel  VERSUS  STATE OF MAHARASHTRA & ANR. Respo  O R D E R 1.
The application bearing IA No. 76535/2026 seeking appropriate directions/ orders is allowed.
2. Leave granted.
3. We have heard the learned counsel appearing for the appellants and the learned counsel appearing for the respondents.

4. The appellants apprehend their arrest in connection with FIR No.241 of 2024 dated 29.06.2024,
registered at Police Station- Kopargoan Rural, District-Ahilyanagar, (Ahmednagar), Maharashtra for the offences punishable under Sections 419, 420, 468, 471 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 Reason: 5.
We have been informed that appellants have joined the investigation pursuant to our orders.

Suffice it to state, that the custodial interrogation of the appellants is not required at this stage, since the investigation is based upon the documentary evidence.
6.
In such view of the matter, we are inclined to set aside the impugned order passed by the High Court and grant anticipatory bail to the appellants.

7. Accordingly, the impugned order stands set aside and the appellants are granted anticipatory bail,
subject to the terms and conditions that may be imposed by the concerned Trial Court.
8. The appeals are allowed, accordingly.
9. Pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of.
